audit.why: Lane difficulty is captured accurately: Lux out-ranges Milio's kick with Q/E through levels 1-5 and first item, Milio flips only once R (Breath of Life) and 2+ items come online.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Light Binding as 'matchup-defining' but never states its actual cooldown, failing the lint's number requirement.
audit.why: Light Binding (Q) is a flat 10s cooldown at every rank per the kit; R Breath of Life scales 160/145/130s. Stating both gives concrete windows instead of vague framing.
audit.corrected: See edits: breakdown.cooldowns now states Q's flat 10s cooldown and R's 160/145/130s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two missingInteractions were never stated: Lux's Prismatic Barrier (W) absorbing Milio's burst window, and Illumination (P)'s auto-attack reset as the tell before her combo lands.
audit.why: Both are load-bearing for the all-in/peel plan and were confirmed applicable by missingInteractions data for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Folded into dosFull[1].d (auto-reset tell cues the E shield) and dontsFull[2].d (Prismatic Barrier absorbs the burst, wait it out).
